## Welcome

Hi, I’m Micah Adler. I am currently a Visting Scientist at MIT CSAIL.  Below is a summary of my work on **artificial intelligence**.

**My approach to research:** First and foremost, I love to collaborate.  If you have similar interests, are wondering about anything I've written, or are working on a problem you think I might be interested in, please reach out.  My background is in theoretical computer science, so I tend to take a "theory first" approach to research, but it is also important to follow that up with real experiments.  I'm interested in all things AI.

**Other research:** If you’re interested in my broader research outside artificial intelligence, check out the [full list of my publications](other-research.qmd).



:::

<script>
// Fix: list.js sorts the "listing-title" field by innerHTML, which includes
// the wrapping <a href="./posts/[file].html"> markup and orders posts by
// filename instead of title text. Override with a textContent comparator.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  function titleSortFn(a, b) {
    const at = (a.elm.querySelector('.listing-title') || {}).textContent || '';
    const bt = (b.elm.querySelector('.listing-title') || {}).textContent || '';
    return at.trim().toLowerCase().localeCompare(bt.trim().toLowerCase());
  }

  function attach() {
    const list = (window['quarto-listings'] || {})['listing-listing'];
    const select = document.getElementById('listing-listing-sort');
    if (!list || !select) return false;
    // Re-sort on initial load so the default title sort uses text content,
    // not the innerHTML that includes the wrapping <a href> markup.
    list.sort('listing-title', { order: 'asc', sortFunction: titleSortFn });
    select.addEventListener('change', function() {
      const opt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
      if (opt && opt.value === 'listing-title') {
        const order = opt.getAttribute('data-direction') || 'asc';
        list.sort('listing-title', { order: order, sortFunction: titleSortFn });
      }
    });
    return true;
  }

  if (!attach()) {
    const iv = setInterval(() => { if (attach()) clearInterval(iv); }, 50);
  }
});
</script>
